title: Teacher-led Gemini Notebook in Google Classroom now offers insight summaries for educators and updated sharing settings for admins, including trusted domains
facebook:
Here's a small win for teachers: Google Classroom now shows you quick summaries of how students used AI notebooks — so you can see engagement at a glance. Admins also get better sharing controls. https://aiworldhq.com/article/google-classroom-s-ai-notebook-now-summarizes-how-students-use-it
